usd_reason: The dollar logged its worst week in over 3 months amid Fed doubts
gold_reason: U.S. Treasury yields fall as oil prices plunge on Iran de-escalation hopes
indices_reason: Treasury yields inch lower as investors await fresh economic data
lead_story: The US Federal Reserve is facing pressure to act on inflation, but recent indicators show it's at its lowest in years, leading to divided opinions among Fed officials on whether to hike interest rates. This uncertainty is causing market volatility and affecting the US dollar. The Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady has also contributed to the ongoing Treasury sell-off.
